subproblem.title: A set that coincides near x with the affine plane x + V has approximate tangent space V at x (Simon Ch. 3, 1.4; used for the open faces in step 6 of the parent proof)
subproblem.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, N ⊆ ℝ^P (Euclid P), x ∈ ℝ^P, V a linear subspace of ℝ^P with dim V = n (Module.finrank ℝ V = n), and r > 0 such that for every y with |y − x| < r: y ∈ N if and only if y − x ∈ V. Then N has approximate tangent space V at x (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x V, Simon Ch. 3, 1.4: dim V = n and ∫_{blowUpMap x λ '' N} f dHⁿ → ∫_V f dHⁿ as λ ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P), where blowUpMap x λ y = λ⁻¹(y − x) and Hⁿ = μHE[n]).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (r : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → 0 < r → (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x r, y ∈ N ↔ y - x ∈ V) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x V
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4 (approximate tangent space), applied in step 6 of the parent proof to sets made of open unit faces ("M' has approximate tangent space V_ι at x"), which coincide with the plane of the face near each of their points.

1. The dimension condition dim V = n holds by hypothesis.

2. Let f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P). Its support is compact, hence bounded: there is R > 0 with f(w) = 0 whenever |w| ≥ R. Let B := ball(0, R) (open, hence Borel).

3. Let 0 < λ < r/R and S_λ := blowUpMap x λ '' N = {λ⁻¹(y − x) : y ∈ N}. Claim: S_λ ∩ B = V ∩ B. If w ∈ S_λ ∩ B, then w = λ⁻¹(y − x) with y ∈ N, and |y − x| = λ|w| < λR < r, so y − x ∈ V by hypothesis and w = λ⁻¹(y − x) ∈ V. Conversely, if w ∈ V ∩ B, let y := x + λw; then |y − x| = λ|w| < r and y − x = λw ∈ V, so y ∈ N by hypothesis, and blowUpMap x λ y = λ⁻¹(λw) = w, so w ∈ S_λ.

4. For every set S ⊆ ℝ^P, since f vanishes off B: ∫_S f dHⁿ = ∫ f d(Hⁿ⌞S) = ∫_B f d(Hⁿ⌞S) (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero) = ∫ f d(Hⁿ⌞(B ∩ S)) (Measure.restrict_restrict, B Borel). Applying this to S = S_λ and S = V and using step 3: ∫_{S_λ} f dHⁿ = ∫_V f dHⁿ for every λ ∈ (0, r/R).

5. The interval (0, r/R) belongs to the filter 𝓝[>] 0, so λ ↦ ∫_{S_λ} f dHⁿ is eventually equal, along 𝓝[>] 0, to the constant ∫_V f dHⁿ, and therefore tends to it (tendsto_const_nhds.congr'). As f was arbitrary, this together with step 1 is HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x V. ∎
proof_key_steps: Every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P) vanishes outside some ball B(0, R).
For 0 < λ < r/R the blow-up λ⁻¹(N − x) coincides with V inside B(0, R).
So the blow-up integrals equal ∫_V f for all small λ, hence converge to it; with dim V = n this is the approximate tangent space property.

audit.reason: For each compactly supported test function, sufficiently small blow-ups agree with V wherever the function can be nonzero. Restriction to a measurable ball justifies equality of integrals even for arbitrary N, proving the exact tangent predicate.
